comments.content:
When you go to edit someone's ID, captain is not in the list of choices.

Bug or intentional?
I see the captain listed in both /stable and /unstable. user error.

Checked again today, captains spare and captain seem to show it, while if you are the
HoP or HoR it isn't there.

This was intentional. HoP shouldn't be able to easily access everything just by
virtue of being HoP - you can only grant permissions you yourself have.
